description: Personal preference memory: consented user facts, corrections, plans.

items.content: The user prefers dark mode and full keyboard navigation (no mouse) in dashboards.
The user's standing design review meeting is every Tuesday at 10:00 local time.
The user's morning drink of choice was black coffee, no sugar.
Correction (2026-03): the user switched from black coffee to green tea in the mornings; do not recommend coffee blends any more.
The user's primary contact email is alice@example.com.
Correction (2026-05): the user's primary email is now alice@work.example.com; the old alice@example.com forwards for 90 days.
Trip plan step 1: book the refundable hotel in Kyoto for the third week of October.
Trip plan step 2: only after the hotel is confirmed, buy the Osaka→Kyoto rail passes (date-locked).
Trip plan step 3: once rail passes are booked, reserve the Kaiseki dinner for two on the Friday evening.
The user reads on an e-ink tablet and prefers sending long documents to it.
The user's podcast queue is refreshed every Sunday evening.
The user tracks groceries with a shared list app, shared with their partner.
